method: Re-implements the installer's manifest validation rules in Python, then re-hashes every manifest artifact against the local transferred/downloaded files.

embedded_worker_wheels_check.install_mechanism: The Windows installer embeds these two wheels with include_bytes! (WINDOWS_SHARED_WORKER_WHEELS) and installs them directly into the v2 runtime's Lib/site-packages during installation, matching the v1 bundled:worker-wheel precedent. They are intentionally NOT Artifacts in `wheels`, so the installer never tries to download them.
